tag: 男子在倉庫走道上推著堆滿紙箱的平台推車

level.why: 單人單一動作題，只需描述推車與紙箱，句型為基本現在進行式，字彙簡單。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of a worker pushing a cart of boxes in a warehouse. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: A simple, uncluttered scene with one clear main subject doing one obvious action (or one obvious object), a plain background and only a few common objects. No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: One man in a blue T-shirt and dark pants is walking in a warehouse.
He is pushing a flat metal cart with both hands on the handle.
Several cardboard boxes are stacked on the cart.
Tall shelves with boxes are on both sides of the aisle.
Wooden pallets are on the right and the floor is concrete.

pool.t: The man is pushing a cart of boxes.
pool.zh: 這名男子正推著一台裝著箱子的推車。
pool.why: 正解：男子雙手推著堆滿紙箱的推車，與畫面相符。

pool.t: He is pushing a trolley loaded with boxes.
pool.zh: 他正推著一台載滿箱子的推車。
pool.why: 正解：平台推車上疊著多個紙箱，男子正在推動，與畫面相符。

pool.t: He is holding the handle of the cart.
pool.why: 正解：男子雙手握著推車後方的把手，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The man is driving a forklift.
pool.zh: 這名男子正在開堆高機。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有堆高機，他是在推手推車。

pool.t: The man is climbing a ladder.
pool.why: 畫面中沒有梯子，他是在地面上推車。

pool.t: He is sitting on the cart.
pool.why: 男子是站著走路推車，並沒有坐在推車上。

pool.t: The man is wearing a yellow helmet.
pool.zh: 這名男子戴著黃色安全帽。
pool.why: 畫面中男子沒有戴安全帽。

pool.t: He is carrying a red toolbox.
pool.zh: 他正提著一個紅色工具箱。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有工具箱，他雙手握著推車把手。

pool.t: There is a truck parked beside the shelves.
The man is pushing a car.
pool.zh: 這名男子正在推一輛汽車。
pool.why: car 與 cart 字形與音近，但他推的是裝箱子的推車，不是汽車。

pool.t: Three men are pushing the cart together.
pool.zh: 三名男子正一起推著推車。
pool.why: 畫面中只有一名男子在推車，人數錯誤。

pool.t: He is delivering boxes to a customer.
pool.why: 畫面中看不出有顧客或送貨目的，這是過度推論。
